blocks.text: Mutlaq (absolute) electrode potentials nahi nape ja sakte kyunke jab element us ke ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to electrical double layer ban jati hai. Jab zinc zinc ions wale solution mein rakha jaye to satah ke bohat thore zinc atoms zinc ions mein badal kar solution mein jate hain, zinc ki satah par electrons ki zyadati chhorte hue. Metal ke ird-gird solution mein ab Zn2+ ions zyada hain, aur satah ke qareeb in cations mein se kuch us ki taraf khinchte hain, to electrical double layer banti hai. Charge ka yeh jama hona metal aur solution ke metal ions ke darmiyan electric potential (voltage) paida karta hai (Figure 10.3).

Double layer ki wajah se potential seedha nahi napa ja sakta, magar metal/metal ion system aur kisi doosre system ke darmiyan potential ka farq napa ja sakta hai. Yeh qeemat electrode potential, E, hai, volts mein; muqable ke liye standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) istemal hota hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: zinc ion solution mein slate rang ki zinc rod jis ki satah par manfi nishan aur saath Zn2+ ions jama hain, double layer ke taur par label shuda. Darmiyan: standard hydrogen electrode jis mein hydrogen gas 1.00 mol dm-3 H+ mein platinum electrode par sheeshe ke bell mein dakhil hoti hai. Daen: standard halaat, teen half-cell qismon, SHE ke muqable +0.34 V aur -0.76 V par nape copper aur zinc half-cells, aur terminals par reduction aur oxidation ke usoolon ka dabba.
blocks.caption: Electrical double layer, standard hydrogen electrode aur standard electrode potentials ki paimaish (Figures 10.3 se 10.6 aur topics 10.11 se 10.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Apne ions ke solution mein dooba metal chand atoms ions ke taur par solution mein bhejta hai, satah par electrons chhorte hue; ions manfi satah ki taraf wapas jama hote hain aur double layer banti hai, jo aisa potential deti hai jo akela napa nahi ja sakta. Use is ke bajaye standard hydrogen electrode ke muqable napa jata hai: 298 K par 1.00 mol dm-3 acid mein platinum black par 101 kPa par bulbule banati hydrogen, jise 0.00 V muqarrar kiya gaya hai. Copper half-cell se jora jaye to voltmeter +0.34 V parhta hai copper musbat pole ke saath, kyunke copper ions hydrogen ions se aasani se reduce hote hain; zinc se jora jaye to -0.76 V zinc manfi pole ke saath, kyunke zinc ions mushkil se reduce hote hain. Reduction musbat terminal par aur oxidation manfi par hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke electrical double layer kaise aur kyun banti hai (exercise Q.2a).
blocks.explanation: Satah ke chand metal atoms electrons kho kar cations ke taur par solution mein jate hain; electrons metal par rehte hain, us ki satah ko manfi banate hue, aur cations wapas khinch kar us satah ke saath lagte hain. Metal par electrons ki tah solution mein cations ki tah ke samne double layer hai, aur alag hua charge potential ka farq deta hai jis ki mutlaq qeemat napi nahi ja sakti, sirf doosre electrode se muqabla ho sakta hai.

items: Zn2+ solution mein zinc: chand atoms ions ke taur par halte hain, metal par zyada electrons chhorte hue; cations satah par jama hote hain: electrical double layer aur potential.
Mutlaq potentials nape nahi ja sakte; reference, SHE, se farq electrode potential E volts mein hai.
